title: Thai-Style Baked Tofu with Peanut Sauce, Green Beans, Mushrooms & Rice

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime.
Add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, maple syrup, chili-garlic sauce, and oil to the bowl. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce.

Cut tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles. Place in a medium bowl, season with salt and pepper, then add half of the peanut sauce (reserve remaining sauce for serving). Stir tofu to coat, then set aside to marinate. (Reserve baking sheet for the next step.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Transfer to the reserved baking sheet.
Trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the onions.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with additional oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Transfer tofu to the baking sheet, nestling it into the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring veggies halfway through, until veggies are tender and tofu is golden, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice, tofu, and veggies between plates. Drizzle remaining sauce over the tofu and enjoy!
